title: [#19371] file-pcapng: check SHB endianness sooner
description:
When dissecting a pcapng file (MIME Files Format) and parsing a SHB,
check its endianness before using its length field to mark bytes for
that block. Prevents the dissector from marking more bytes for a block
than actually belong to that block, in the specific case where a file
contains a second SHB of different endianness than that of the first
SHB.

Also hardens other aspects of the dissection in the case of a second SHB
which has invalid byte order magic.

Closes #19371

All of this has been moved down into `dissect_pcapng()`, so the endianness can be tested as early as possible before proceeding with parsing the rest of the block.

Why not test the endianness, and if it is bad, take a subset of length 12 (the minimum length of a block, and where it will stop anyway) and pass it into `dissect_block`? Slightly change it around so that `dissect_block` adds the magic item and expert info rather than trying to compute the length where it would set the bad magic to true.

Seems like less code duplication that way.
